resources.string: Your game wishlist, in one place
QuestLog keeps track of the games you want to play, and tells you when they come out.
Search the whole catalogue, or let Discover suggest games based on the ones you have saved.
Keep as many lists as you like, and give each game a play status to keep track of your backlog.
Radar shows when your saved games come out. Turn on a reminder for any of them.
